newsitem.title: USA: Ensco Intl has letter of intent for rig.
newsitem.headline: Ensco Intl has letter of intent for rig.

text.p: Ensco International said on Wednesday that it has a letter of intent for a jackup drilling rig in the Gulf of Mexico for a dayrate of "around" $80,000, a spokesman for the company said.
He declined to name the contractor but said that if the contract was firmed up, it would be announced in the next few weeks.

Dayrates for offshore rigs in the Gulf of Mexico have firmed due to strong demand and tight supply, and recent contracts with high dayrates combined with the strong earnings outlook for the sector have pushed rig company stocks back to the level of their January highs.
Ensco closed up 5-15/16 at 59-3/4 today. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
